note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MAL 10(1); A06b MAL 10(1); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence (the 5 of the past 7 years the provision asks; the dataset's own count is 7); no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Wedlock restriction), A01b (descent, born abroad: Wedlock restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: Generally applicable provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a wedlock restriction (a child born out of wedlock may not take it from a citizen father), which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Malta, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Malta for at least 5 of the past 7 years preceding the application. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... Wedlock restriction ... Person is born in Malta and in wedlock to a citizen, or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen. ... Wedlock restriction ... Person is born abroad and in wedlock to a citizen who has acquired citizenship otherwise than by descent, or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen. ... No provision ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born on or after the 1st August, 1989 and is a descendant in the direct line of an ascendant born in Malta of a parent likewise born in Malta. Person must take the oath of allegiance and not be contrary to public interest.

atBirth.soilIf: Person is born on or after the 1st August, 1989 and is a descendant in the direct line of an ascendant born in Malta of a parent likewise born in Malta. Person must take the oath of allegiance and not be contrary to public interest.
atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad and in wedlock to a citizen who has acquired citizenship otherwise than by descent, or out of wedlock to a mother who is a citizen.
